elements.name: Plaza Mayor (pedestrian square)
elements.material: large-format grey/beige stone slabs with fine joints and linear drainage channels (photo-seen); cobble strip near Ayuntamiento (photo-seen)
elements.notes: OSM polygon 16 vertices; area 3058 m2; bounds x -3724.8..-3627.8, z -1888.1..-1812.4. Polygon encloses the east edge of the Iglesia Mayor footprint. No fountain, kiosk, terrace or raised level seen in photos inside the polygon.

elements.name: Iglesia Mayor San Juan Bautista
elements.confidence: OSM-only (position, heritage tags) + photo-seen (facade). Footprint Catastro idx 65036 (1 floor in Catastro)
elements.notes: Neoclassical main facade facing the square (SW side). Triangular pediment with carved group (two angels and coat of arms, photo-seen). Round-arched portal with dark timber doors, balcony with balustrade above portal, round oculi and pilasters (photo-seen). Dome is pale blue-white tile behind, seen from west. Granite-faced steps up to portal. Commons description credits Torcuato Cayon de la Vega (text-described). Catastro says 1 floor; the facade reads 2 levels (portal plus upper balcony) so the Catastro count is probably understated.

elements.name: Torre del Reloj (Arquillo del Reloj)
elements.material: brown-ochre sandstone/brick masonry (photo-seen estimate); tiled dome of red/white checkered ceramic with Greek-key band
elements.confidence: OSM-only (position, tags) + photo-seen (plaque, form, clock, arch, dome). Height not in any source (guessed)
elements.notes: Built 1759-1767 on the old Casas Consistoriales site (plaque on wall, photo-seen). BIC since 1985 (plaque). Bell tower of Iglesia Mayor. Clock face on the lower stage facing the square; bell stage with two arched openings per face; tiled dome. Ground stage has a round-arch passage into Calle Arquillo del Reloj (OSM tunnel=building_passage, photo-seen). Catastro nearest footprint idx 67292 (2 floors, 7.5x10 m) is too small; OSM way 184182532 is the better footprint.

elements.name: Ayuntamiento de Chiclana (Calle Constitucion 1)
elements.material: ochre/yellow render with white stone (pilasters, cornices, balustrade) (photo-seen estimate)
elements.confidence: OSM-only (address, amenity=townhall) + photo-seen (facade). NOT adjacent to the Plaza Mayor: about 307 m from plaza centre
elements.notes: Neoclassical facade: ochre walls, white pilasters, round oculi in arched attic bays, balustraded balcony with orange-salmon banners bearing the coat of arms, arched ground-floor doorways with fan-shaped iron grilles, wall lanterns (photo-seen). Four flagpoles on the balcony line (Spain, Andalusia, EU, and a red/purple flag). Metal letters "Chiclana" on a round planter with water feature and "Agua no potable" sign (photo-seen). Catastro idx 59777, 3 floors.

elements.name: Monumento al Padre Francisco (Francisco Javier Almandoz Arburua)
elements.confidence: photo-seen (statue, plinth, by church steps); identity text-described (Commons). Coordinates not measured
elements.notes: Standing priest in cassock with glasses, holding a book (photo-seen). Stands on a granite block plinth on the east side near the church, beside a fan palm (photo-seen in Plaza Mayor 06 and Planomato image). Commons: Padre Almandoz, died 26 Mar 1990. Dimensions guessed.

elements.notes: Plate: "Batalla de Chiclana 5 de marzo de 1811 / Bicentenario de la Batalla de Chiclana / Marzo de 2010" (photo-seen). Silhouette of raised hands and figures. Dimensions estimated from photo. Stands on bare earth/gravel, so it is at the edge, not on the paving.
